_comment_stations: journey.origin/destination: 'name' is what the fleet tab shows; with 'station' (an OSM station name on the corridor, prefix match) the map pins it at that station, otherwise at the corridor end as 'from …' / 'to …'.
_comment: Where each case happens in the real world, and how it is shown. The single place to change a scenario's geography: the frontend (map, fleet tab, routes) and soteria-frontend/scripts/fetch-rail-corridors.mjs both read this file. Train and incident facts stay in data/<case_id>/ and are read from there, never copied. After changing a 'corridor' block run: node soteria-frontend/scripts/fetch-rail-corridors.mjs <route id>
_comment_journey: journey.departure_time/arrival_time are the timetable, in UTC like the incident timestamp in data/<case_id>/. travel_time_min and progress_pct describe the train at the moment of the incident; the ETA is derived from arrival_time, so keep all of them in step when an incident time changes.
_comment_initial_focus: case_id the map opens on, framed close up. null opens the world overview.
